info.title: Financial Ledger API (Team QUASAR)
info.description: Double-entry digital wallet and ledger. Money is always an integer number of minor units (amountMinor, paise for INR). Errors use the ErrorResponse schema; codes are listed per operation.

500.description: INTERNAL_ERROR - rolled back, no partial effect

post.summary: Create a wallet in a supported currency (FR-WAL-01, FR-WAL-03, FR-WAL-04)

500.description: INTERNAL_ERROR - rolled back, no partial effect

post.summary: Transfer to another USER wallet in the same currency (FR-TRF-01..14). 201 on success; 422 with a FAILED transaction ID when a business rule rejects it; a retry with the same key replays the stored response.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 8-64 characters of letters, digits, '-' and '_'. Reuse it only when retrying the same request.

500.description: INTERNAL_ERROR - rolled back, no partial effect

201.description: Created. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the stored 201 or 422 unchanged, with header Idempotent-Replayed: true.

422.description: INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, WALLET_NOT_ACTIVE, CURRENCY_MISMATCH, SAME_WALLET, INVALID_DESTINATION, NOT_REVERSIBLE

503.description: SERVICE_BUSY - write lock timeout; retry with the same Idempotency-Key (Retry-After header)
